concepts.name: Symmetrical Designs
concepts.definition: Central learning focus developed by the chapter 'Symmetrical Designs'.
concepts.evidence: While preparing cutouts of letters, they observe that some letters can be cut out in an easy way.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Using chapter information to support an explanation or answer.
concepts.evidence: They remember that they learnt about reflection symmetry and lines of symmetry in Grade 4.

concepts.name: Application
concepts.definition: Using the chapter idea in a new but related situation.
concepts.evidence: They used their knowledge of lines of symmetry to make the cutouts.
